text:
amelia: Trying to sketch a Grafana dashboard to catch rack-level power sags that coincide with GPU fan spikes and job backpressure. Thinking: pair power draw, fan_rpm, queue depth, and tail latencies. Anyone already built something like this?
cheng: we have node-level panels but not rack-sag correlation. good call to join metrics. start with aggregated by `rack` label.
amelia: yep. rough prom queries i was thinking:
```
# rack avg GPU util
avg by (rack) (gpu_utilization_percent{env="prod"})
# rack power draw
sum by (rack) (node_power_watts{env="prod"})
# fan rpm p95 per rack
quantile_over_time(0.95, fan_rpm{env="prod"}[5m])
```
cheng: add queue depth from scheduler/exporter (jobs_pending_per_node) and a derived backpressure metric: `jobs_pending / (gpus_per_node * nodes_in_rack)` to normalize.
dario: for alerts: avoid noisy flapping. something like:
```
alert: RackPowerSag
expr: (sum by (rack) (node_power_watts{env="prod"}) < rack_power_baseline * 0.85) and (increase(jobs_pending_total{env="prod"}[5m]) > 10)
for: 10m
```
morgan: UI tips — place a compact heatmap for per-node memory pressure (mem_used_percent) under the rack map, and a small timeseries row for `p99_sched_latency` so you can eyeball latency spikes aligned to power/fan events.
amelia: nice. also want a panel that flags nodes with thermal throttle events. our exporter exposes `gpu_throttle_count` — show cumulative and diff over 1h to highlight hotspots.
cheng: for SLO dashboards: show a rollup of request p50/p95/p99 alongside token/sec and cost-per-token for that rack cluster. then overlay maintenance windows or autoscaler events as annotations.
dario: probe links: make panel links to the pod logs + `kubectl` runbook. add template var `rack` so you can filter down.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: grafana-dashboard/changes applied to pref-gpu-rack-sag (dash id: 9921) by morgan at 1798765500
amelia: thanks, ill prototype a JSON model for the dashboard. one ask: does anyone have a good baseline calculation for `rack_power_baseline`? currently thinking 95th percentile over last 7d minus maintenance windows.
cheng: baseline = max(0.9, 0.95 * quantile_over_time(0.95, sum by (rack) (node_power_watts{env="prod"})[7d:1h])) — but exclude known scale events.
morgan: when we tune alerting, gate it behind `rack == production-critical` label so it doesn't ping on dev racks. also use `for: 10m` and require `p95_gpu_util > 70%` to reduce false positives.
amelia: perfect. i'll push a minimal dashboard JSON with these panels and a link to the runbook. will ping here when ready for review. :thumbsup:
